dataset.name: Ego2Web
dataset.license_or_access_note: Local research access follows the Ego2Web dataset terms; this manifest records derived evidence but does not assume that source videos may be redistributed.

original_annotations: On wikipedia.org, open the article for the exact tabletop game being played in the video and report how many pieces are in a standard retail set. Also state the name of the section where this count appears.

On amazon.com, find a product page for the same game set as in the video in its regular size (not miniature or oversized). It must be Prime-eligible and have an average rating of at least 4 stars. Provide the current price and the total number of customer ratings.

supported_claims.text: The ordered packet clearly shows one wooden block-stacking game being played at a table, supporting the shared game referent without exposing any website rating information.

tasks.rejection_reason: One image grounds the block-stacking game and B only adds website attributes, so the same commitment does not require an unfolding glasses session.

original_annotations: On YouTube, find and open a step-by-step tutorial that shows how to reload the cutting line on the exact grass trimmer head shown in the video.
On ebay, locate and open a product page for a replacement pre-wound spool or complete trimmer head that matches the exact head used in the video.

supported_claims.text: All eight frames show the wearer opening and handling the same grass-trimmer head, supporting the grass-trimmer-head category but not a manufacturer or model.

tasks.rejection_reason: A single image of the trimmer head plus the complete install-and-reload request leads to the same tutorial choice and web action; delaying the second requirement changes only delivery time, not the Glass-Use decision.

original_annotations: On Amazon, find the product listing that matches the second poster shown in the video.
Using Wikipedia, identify who created the second poster shown in the video.
On Quora, find a discussion about whether the second poster shown in the video is from WWI or WWII.

supported_claims.text: The continuous packet shows two temporally ordered poster candidates: a solar-system poster first and an Uncle Sam poster second.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent detect that a request referring only to one of two successively examined posters is underdetermined and ask which ordinal position is intended?
construct.belief_before: Either the solar-system poster or the Uncle Sam poster can satisfy the unqualified request.
construct.belief_after: The answer 'the second poster' uniquely selects the Uncle Sam poster.
construct.required_behavior_change: Ask before committing to a poster, then select the second poster after the answer.
construct.no_update_failure: The Agent guesses a poster before asking or selects the first poster after the answer.
construct.overupdate_failure: The Agent asks in the oracle arm even though the ordinal is already supplied.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The packet supplies the two poster appearances and their temporal order; text alone does not identify either poster.

task_blueprint.ambiguous_instruction: Find the poster I looked at in the room and add one matching print to the cart.
task_blueprint.oracle_instruction: Find the second poster I looked at in the room and add one matching print to the cart.
task_blueprint.canonical_question: Do you mean the first poster I examined or the second one?
task_blueprint.completion_claim: The submitted cart contains exactly one print matching the second, Uncle Sam poster and no extra products.

original_annotations: On walmart.com, find product pages for the exact energy drink variant the shopper grabs from the cooler and the energy drink beside the one shopper grabs.

supported_claims.text: The packet stably shows a green Monster can as an anchor, black-and-gold Rockstar cans immediately to its left, and blue NOS cans immediately to its right.

tasks.rejection_reason: One static cooler photograph contains the anchor and both neighbors and produces the same left/right clarification decision.

original_annotations: On YouTube, find a video that introduces or features the same type of glass container as the second one picked up by the person in the video.

tasks.rejection_reason: Dense review of 40-60 seconds shows several bottles, flasks and glass vessels in the active workspace. Removing the ordinal does not yield exactly two stable same-type candidates, and an eight-frame packet cannot recover a unique two-candidate sequence without relying on the source answer.

original_annotations: Please find on Amazon the first snack that the man touches in the video and report its average price.
Please find on Amazon the snack that is at left of the first snack that the man touches in the video and report its average price.

tasks.rejection_reason: The 50-54 second interaction is partially occluded by another shopper and a phone, while the shelf contains several products on both sides. The actual first touched snack and a two-candidate left/right set cannot both be recovered reliably from the proposed eight images.
